current_difficulty_reason: The standard interior and noncharacteristic Witten models do not cover actual Morse critical points on the boundary where the normal derivative vanishes. The authors construct a new characteristic half-space model without simultaneously block-diagonalizing the potential and metric, and establish the degree-dependent normal-mode kernel and uniform spectral gap through the complete localized splitting and metric-comparison argument. Their new model determines exactly which negative normal Hessian points contribute an index shift, then the fully written localization and spectral projection estimates exclude any extra small eigenforms.
